blueprint.public_state: The evaluation closed on August 22 after 54,216 completed US orders. The product decision is to keep the apartment text supplied by iOS and remove the second normalization pass in version 9.20. Carrier corrections fell from 0.91% to 0.42%, checkout completion remained effectively flat at 78.5% versus 78.6%, and address-related support contacts declined by 27 per 10,000 orders. Payments Mobile owns the August 27 rollout and will halt it if carrier corrections exceed 0.70% in a daily cohort. The release record contains the analysis workbook, review notes, and owner checklist.
